name: Gizmo
audience: Students wanting fast AI flashcards from content.
positioning: AI flashcard app focused on speed and ease of generation.
weaknesses: No notes, mind maps, podcasts, or quizzes
pricingNote: Free with paid; do not quote prices.
commonPraise: Fast to make cards; clean mobile UX; quick win for cramming.
commonComplaints: Narrow feature set; depth limited for serious subjects; AI quality varies.
positioningVsNomi: Gizmo is a fast flashcard maker; Nomi generates a complete study set — notes, quizzes, mind maps, podcasts, study guide plus spaced repetition — from the same source so you study more than cards.
